headline: High school consolidation application to the state, middle school design study, and a contract with the Portland Administrators Association.
summary: The meeting will take up a second reading of the high school state application for school consolidation. It will also cover a middle school design update and adoption of a contract with the Portland Administrators Association.
items: Public comment on items not on this evening's agenda
Review of personnel items: resignations, terminations, position shifts, and other hires
Finance, Personnel and Operations Committee report
Curriculum and Student Success Committee report
Public and Legislative Affairs Committee report
Foundation for Portland Public Schools quarter one report
High school state application second read: resolve to submit the application for school consolidation to the State Department of Education
Adoption of the collective bargaining agreement with the Portland Administrators Association
Executive session to discuss contract negotiations with the Portland Administrators Association under 1 M.R.S.A. § 405(6)(D)
location: Casco Bay High School (in person) and Zoom (https://tinyurl.com/3c3tayaj)
